# ONEWAY

> ONEWAY, at oneway.center, gives every person one profile and every community or business a Center. It is a
> unified, fully customizable social network (the ONEWAY App) and the operating system behind it (ONEWAY OS).
> It is made by Oneway Technologies LLC, a New York limited liability company, and is in closed beta. ONEWAY is
> not affiliated with other services that use the name Oneway.

We grant users and Centers absolute sovereignty over their data, what they display, and how they interact, whether
hosting a simple photo gallery or a business's entire website.

## What ONEWAY is

- [About ONEWAY](https://oneway.center/about.html): the ecosystem, the App, ONEWAY OS and its three tiers
- The ONEWAY App: your unified and fully customizable social network. You see what your friends and the places you
  love are posting, and what is coming up at each of them.
- ONEWAY OS: from managing online communities, developing custom tools, to running full businesses and zooming in on
  the operations of specific locations with the click of a button, within seconds.
  - ONEWAY OS: a free operating environment with the basic capabilities of a Center
  - ONEWAY Business OS: the full business operating system, with the Brain, Systems, Agents, Cross Projection and
    operational intelligence
  - ONEWAY Developer OS: the developer platform for building applications, systems, integrations, agents and custom
    experiences on ONEWAY
